overall_summary: Analysis of the performance data clearly indicates that husband-wife and relationship reality topics (e.g., 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' and 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?') significantly outperform general poetry or single-topic family emotional clips, generating over 1,600 to 1,700 views compared to the baseline 100-300 views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on married life dynamics (e.g., or5gtaBpRVY with 1674 views, my5mP9feI7s with 1767 views) received nearly 10x the views of standard family emotional shorts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marriage and partner relationship topics, particularly unspoken emotional burdens between spouses.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' (YdWh4cDOE64) stalled at 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Move away from overly dramatic, bitter poetry and focus instead on grounded, everyday relational observations.

next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that it's not lack of love, but the exhaustion of daily life making them forget how to just check in on each other.
next_video.reason: Matches the proven high-performing husband-wife relationship content window and theme.
